GodwinMix.alt: The GodwinMix web UI in a browser, mixing four live RTMP test sources (SMPTE bars, an ffmpeg test pattern, a moving gradient and a cellular automaton). Each source is picked into Preview and taken to Programme in turn while one RTMP destination stays live.
GodwinMix.credit: Recorded from a local GodwinMix release build on macOS (Apple Silicon, VideoToolbox hardware encode) against a local mediamtx server. All sources are ffmpeg generated test signals.

GodwinMix.alt: GodwinMix web UI: Preview showing the four camera multiview, the TAKE and CUT buttons with Fade, Wipe and Dip transitions, Programme on Camera 1, and the Scenes, Sources and Graphics panels below.
GodwinMix.credit: Local GodwinMix build, ffmpeg generated test sources.

pstop.alt: pstop running in Windows Terminal: per core CPU bars, memory and swap meters, and a scrolling process list with tree view, sort menu and the F key toolbar along the bottom.

psnet.alt: psnet network monitor on Windows: download and upload graphs, a dashboard with current throughput, a live traffic table of processes, hosts, services and connection states, and a wire packet preview pane.

vigil.alt: vigil running in a Debian container on a lab host named lab-01, stepping through its views: command center, attack radar with a braille world map, alerts, doors (ports 22, 80 and 6379 exposed), network pulse, geography, topology and system.
vigil.credit: Built from psmux/vigil source and run as root in a throwaway Debian container with sshd, nginx and an unauthenticated Redis on 0.0.0.0. The SSH brute force entries are real failed logins made against the container from inside it, and outbound traffic is real HTTPS to public sites.

vigil.alt: vigil Attack Radar view: 24 hour attack heatmap, SSH brute force counts, an attack origins world map, top attackers table and recent alerts.
vigil Doors view: an exposure donut for 3 listening ports, firewall coverage, and rows for sshd on :22, nginx on :80 and redis-server on :6379 each marked EXPOSED.

TerminalMap.alt: TerminalMap in a terminal, starting from the braille world map, turning on demo markers and zooming continuously into Europe and then Berlin until individual roads, lakes and suburbs such as Potsdam and Teltow are drawn in braille characters.
TerminalMap.credit: terminalmap 0.1.0 installed with cargo install terminalmap, recorded with VHS on macOS. Map data from OpenStreetMap.

TerminalMap.alt: TerminalMap marker tour: the camera flies from the world view to Berlin, then Paris, then towards London, with labelled markers and country borders drawn in braille.
TerminalMap.credit: terminalmap 0.1.0, recorded with VHS. Map data from OpenStreetMap.

TerminalMap.alt: TerminalMap world view rendered in braille characters with country labels and the key help bar.

Tmux-Plugin-Panel.alt: Tmux Plugin Panel on the Themes tab: a list of tmux theme plugins with star counts (tmux-powerline, Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night and others) and a detail pane for the selected plugin.

omp-manager.alt: Oh My Posh Manager dashboard: a Quick Actions menu with Quick Setup, Browse Themes, Install Fonts, Update Oh My Posh and Reset to Default.

tmuxtop.alt: tmuxtop listing three tmux sessions (dev, notes, web) with their windows, panes and processes, live CPU and memory graphs per process, and gzip and bzip2 jobs pinned near 100 percent CPU.
tmuxtop.credit: tmuxtop.py from psmux/tmuxtop run on macOS against an isolated tmux server, recorded with VHS.

tmuxtop.alt: tmuxtop showing one tmux session with two windows, per pane processes and CPU and memory columns.

missing.reason: No screenshots, GIFs or videos in the repo or README. The plugins run inside psmux on Windows only, so no fresh capture was possible on this Mac.

No media in the repo. On macOS the binary hands off to a Lima Linux VM that builds Psroot from a local source checkout, so a short fresh capture was not practical; the Windows AppContainer mode cannot run here.
